summary: The bot was removed or banned from the chat.

match_any.description_exact: Forbidden: bot was kicked from the group chat
Forbidden: bot was kicked from the supergroup chat
Forbidden: bot was kicked from the channel chat

possible_causes: An active group records the bot as kicked.
The supergroup or channel membership status is banned.
diagnostic_limits: The response does not identify who removed the bot or guarantee that rejoining is currently allowed.

evidence.note: An active group with a kicked bot fails edit or write access.
Banned supergroup and channel memberships produce the corresponding descriptions.

response.description: Forbidden: bot was kicked from the group chat

preconditions: An authorized chat administrator must restore the bot’s access before the application resumes the operation.
